title: Control every bounded row test without output enumeration
statement: For ANY g:[K]^r->[-1,1], let G_g(x)=E g(Z1,...,Zr) with conditional IID Cat(x) labels. It is degree r. For tangent increments h_j with zero coordinate sum and l<=r, |D^l G_g(x)[h1,...,hl]|<=(r)_l product||h_j||1. Expand by replacing l distinct factors with signed measures; each term is bounded by the product of l1 norms. It does not provide an oracle for arbitrary g evaluation or control D^l(P_s G_g).
